summary: End-to-end regression on Blade Academy (ex-FormaPro) after rebrand + new EDOF 'groupement' feature. Backend: 31/31 pytest pass (auth, CRUD x5, sessions+status, dashboard incl. ca_cpf, factures-cpf list/stats/re-import idempotent, EDOF preview, EDOF commit groupement='mois' -> 2 sessions, groupement='exact' -> 4 sessions, 8 PDF doc types, classer + apprenant documents, upload+soft-delete, fusion apprenants, qualité doublons, parametres organisme GET/PUT, purge-demo idempotent). Frontend: login -> dashboard (KPI 'dont 889 480 € CPF encaissés' visible), /sessions Kanban + view-list-btn + search, /apprenants with 'Importer EDOF (CPF)' button + ImportEdofDialog (dropzone -> mapping step -> groupement radios with data-testid edof-groupement-mois & edof-groupement-exact -> commit), /facturation showing 20-row paginated table with total 889 480 €, /parametres with Qualité/doublons/purge-demo, SessionDetail Gestion tab with 8 doc cards (convention, contrat, convocation, attestation, facture, émargement, programme, évaluation), each with 'Générer le PDF' + 'Classer dans les fiches' buttons. DB clean state restored after tests (0 leftover sessions/apprenants).

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS='*' + httpOnly credential cookies is contradictory per spec; FastAPI mitigates by echoing origin but production should pin to explicit origins (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL).
JWT not blacklisted server-side; cookies are cleared but token remains valid until exp (8h). MVP-acceptable.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer logs 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warning on first render (carry-over from iteration_1; chart still renders correctly). Add explicit minHeight to silence.

action_items: Optional: pin CORS_ORIGINS to explicit REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL instead of '*' (credentials + wildcard is spec-violating).
Optional: add minHeight to Dashboard recharts ResponsiveContainer wrapper to silence width=-1 warning.
Optional: consider JWT blacklist or shorter access-token TTL + refresh rotation for production hardening.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1480 lines — split into routers (auth, crud_factory, sessions, dashboard, edof_import, factures_cpf, documents, fusion, parametres) to keep <700 lines per module as suggested in iteration_1.
EDOF commit (server.py:723-879) duplicates apprenant find-or-create logic that could be extracted; financeur_cpf find-or-create is similar.
PDF generation is synchronous (ReportLab) inside async handlers — wrap in run_in_executor when scaling.
Generic CRUD factory PUT writes full payload.model_dump() without preserving server-managed timestamps (id is matcher so safe).
Idempotency of EDOF commit: when groupement='mois', re-running with same data results in sessions_maj=2 (no duplicate created) — confirmed working.
fusion endpoint expects 'apprenant_ids' (snake_case) — fine, but doc test_credentials.md could mention it for consistency.
